title: Ukraine war latest: 'We're going to have Europe do that' - Trump plays down chances of US security for Ukraine

title: Ukraine's Zelenskyy says framework economic deal with US is ready but security guarantees undecided
description: KYIV, Ukraine (AP) — A framework economic deal with the United States is ready, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Wednesday, but U.S. security guarantees that Kyiv views as vital for its war with Russia remain to be decided and a full agreement could hinge on talks in Washington as early as Friday.

title: Ukraine war latest: Can Putin be trusted? Which countries are at risk if not? | Michael Clarke answers your questions
